name: Aeba Tomoe
source: A woman with a cool personality that lives according to her beliefs, regardless of the common sense and morals of the world. She is a pleasurer, she is liked by others regardless of gender. Many students have been calling her “Tomoe-sensei”. Tomoe is an old friend of [url=/c2552]Ryou[/url]. Their mothers are sisters.
